pages.text: Klein Stars are portable EMC batteries. Each tier holds more EMC, and tools that need fuel drain from a star before touching your own pool.$(br2)The tiers and their capacities:$(br2)$(li)$(l)Ein:$() 50,000 EMC.$(li)$(l)Zwei:$() 200,000 EMC.$(li)$(l)Drei:$() 800,000 EMC.$(li)$(l)Vier:$() 3,200,000 EMC.$(li)$(l)Sphere:$() 12,800,000 EMC.$(li)$(l)Omega:$() 51,200,000 EMC.$(br2)$(l)How to get them:$() craft Ein from 8 Mobius Fuel and 1 diamond. Each higher tier is made from four of the tier below.

$(l)Using them:$() put a star in your inventory or in the dedicated $(l)Klein Star curio slot$(). It fills and empties automatically as you use EMC tools. You can also charge one in an $(l:emc_generation/collectors_relays)Energy Collector$() or $(l:emc_generation/collectors_relays)Relay$(), or directly from your EMC pool in a $(l:emc_transmutation/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$().$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()

$(li)The $(l:utilities/mercurial_eye)Mercurial Eye$() uses a Klein Star as its fuel source; insert one in its GUI.$(li)Relays can also drain a star from the burn slot to refill their buffer.$(li)In this version, recipes that use a Klein Star (the $(l:emc_transmutation/tome_of_knowledge)Tome of Knowledge$() and the Gem Armor) require a $(l)fully charged$() Omega by default.$(br2)$(l)Server settings:$() the full-star recipe rule is common.crafting.fullKleinStars.
